summary: Shissler Peak's 1953 L-4 cab in the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness replaced a 1933 tower and remains a staffed, hike-in lookout.

access.note: Hike-in only, within the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness; staffed in fire season, not a public rental.

visit.trail_note: Reached on foot through wilderness terrain.

events.note: First lookout: an L-4 cab on a pole tower.
Current 1936-model L-4 cab with catwalk built on a 10-foot treated timber tower.
Laura Grace Simon staffed the lookout.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register, April 24, 2009.

evidence.quote: The Nez Perce National Forest built Shissler Peak Lookout in 1933. It was an L-4 cab on a pole tower. In l953 the current 1936 model L-4 with catwalk was constructed on a 10' treated timber tower.

evidence.supports: Location above Moose Creek/Selway River confluence, in wilderness
evidence.quote: Shissler Peak sits above the confluence of Moose Creek and the Selway River within the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness Area in the Nez Perce National Forest. Shissler is regularly staffed for fire detection.

evidence.supports: 1933 L-4 tower, hike-in access, staffing names

evidence.quote: Know more about who staffed this tower, or when? Let us know .

evidence.supports: Staffing: Penny Kummrow 1967, Laura Grace Simon 2010
evidence.quote:
1967

evidence.supports: 1953 timber tower replacing 1933 L-4, staffed, Gary Hannon 1956
evidence.quote: This 1953 10' treated timber tower with L-4 cab, which replaced an earlier 1933 L-4 tower, is regularly staffed in the summer. Known lookout personnel: 1956: Gary Hannon.

corrections.current: Laura Grace Simon staffed the lookout in 1967
corrections.proposed: Penny Kummrow staffed 1967; Laura Grace Simon is listed under 2010, not 1967
corrections.why: The original note conflated two separate names from Idaho Fire Lookouts' staffing list, which gives Penny Kummrow for 1967 and Laura Grace Simon for 2010.

notes_for_editor: Staffing record is thin (only two named years found) and both Idaho Fire Lookouts notes it is incomplete; story mentions this limitation rather than implying a full record. Corrected a mismatched name/year: the 1967 staffer was Penny Kummrow, not Laura Grace Simon (who staffed in 2010).
